description: Run the Textures check rules on files you wrote (the Texture's files and the host CSS): easing family, duration scale, reduced motion, focus parity, animatable properties, host sizing. Returns findings with a fix each; iterate until ok.

files.description: The Texture's files as written into the project (.tsx, .ts, .js, .css, .html).

host.description: What the host gives the Texture: its CSS and, if known, its box in px.

manifest.description: A texture.json as an object, when you have one and give no ref.

ref.description: The Texture's slug: its catalog manifest (touch, fit, reduced motion) is read for you. Omit for hover code that is not a Texture.

style_lock.description: The project's textures.json as an object, when present.

name: check_textures
title: Check Textures
